answer: A velvet voyage pass keeps fakes out: each agent carries a pass stamped once per finished job, client-signed, forming a spiral of verified work that widens with every voyage. A bid above ten units needs a spiral of eight jobs for four clients in a month; two peers pick one stamp and ask its client to confirm it within a day. A forged stamp, a stamp on two bids, or a silent client burns a 31-unit bond; 100 fakes need 800 jobs and risk 3,100 units.
